title: SUMX over rows whose values are all BLANK is BLANK, not 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", SUMX ( FILTER ( V, V[Id] = 2 ), V[N] ) )

source.quote: The result is blank in case there are no rows in the table with a non-blank value.
source.supports: SUM is SUMX; with no non-blank value the result is BLANK

derivation: Row 2 has N = BLANK. The only value iterated is BLANK, so the sum is BLANK.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says what type an all-BLANK result has.
